claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b083] Scope decisions for this batch (source: results/55maps-mcc-v2-summary/report.md, whole document, lines 1-119). Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore NOT extracted: dates and timestamps (2026-04-27, 2026-04-28, 2026-05-03, 2026-04-26); git commit hashes (42ed1d32, 163161a4, bdd61bcc, 98b128ae, 7b7509d5); Obs identifiers (Obs 252, 272, 280, 284); the candidate identifier cand 2397; working-notes line-number citations (L13642, L11047); section numbers (## 1 - ## 7, the section-2 back-reference in the phrase 'row refreshes in §2'); the version string '(v2)' in the title; and numbers inside file paths or condition names (the 384 in the bounds path, '55maps' inside filenames, 't0.3' inside run directory names). Temperature designators 'T=0.3' and 'T=0.7' are treated as condition NAMES throughout this document (rule 5 names 't0.3' explicitly) — they never appear here as an asserted run parameter, only as row/column labels. Buffer radii appearing purely to identify which row a metric belongs to ('F1 at R = 50 m as the headline', lines 85-86; 'from R=50 m to R=150 m', line 75; 'the 150 m row' at line 94) are treated as context, not claims; radii asserted as an input convention, as a table row, or as a result (the 125 m practitioner cap, the 75 m crossover) ARE extracted. Repeated restatements of the same buffer grid (lines 18, 23, 63, 115) are each extracted as their own claim because each is a separate assertion (input convention, MCC invariance, section heading, reproducibility command). ANCHOR NOTE: the per-run MCC artefacts the document cites at results/<run>/mcc/evaluation.json are no longer at that path; they live at archive/55maps-superseded-gt-evals/per-run/<run>/mcc/evaluation.json and that archived path is used as the anchor throughout. GT NOTE: the document describes the same canonical GT file as having 4,744 features (line 16) and 4,745 mounds (lines 7, 27, 36, 99); both are recorded verbatim from their own spans against len:$.features on inputs/vectors/references/student-mounds-55maps-reviewed.geojson and are NOT reconciled here.
